Note: An error raised in OnQueryClosePage reaches AL raw ("QCE close refused by OnQueryClosePage") instead of arriving as the unhandled UI a real client shows. Tracked as #3057, with PR #3181 open against it. Pulled in by this PR's submodule pin bump to b1fdb6d7, NOT caused by it: the bump is how corpus #216 (the system-field CalcFormula/TableRelation tests this PR fixes) enters the tree, and corpus history is linear, so #216 cannot be taken without the corpus PRs merged before it. The issue linked here stays open after this PR merges; the fix for it removes this entry.
